method:
SEARCH: I used Studio search_asset (creator_store) plus the public Creator Store API (apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v2/assets:search?searchCategoryType=Audio&query=..&userId=..), filtered to licensed or Roblox-owned uploaders. Creator userIds: Roblox=1, ProSoundEffects=7462895450, APMOfficial=7462718749, DistrokidOfficial=7135127272. I picked a user-uploaded Creator Store sound only where those uploaders had nothing cartoony. Those carry takedown risk and their notes say so.

VERIFY: Studio "Place1" stayed in Edit mode the whole time. For every id I ran execute_luau: Sound in SoundService with SoundId rbxassetid://<id>, ContentProvider:PreloadAsync, then waited up to 5 s for IsLoaded and TimeLength > 0, then destroyed it. All 120+ candidates passed, including every primary and backup here. The check does reject ids that don't load: two other ids (130776150, 2789975069) returned IsLoaded=false. I took creator and name from MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo, and every user upload reported IsPublicDomain=true.

LOUDNESS: I wired each id through AudioPlayer -> Wire -> AudioAnalyzer (no output device, so nothing played aloud) and recorded PeakLevel, RmsLevel and the time to the first sound. Suggested volumes come from these numbers. They are the per-sound Sound.Volume, applied on top of the SoundGroup volumes in src/shared/Audio.lua:29 (Music 0.5, SFX 0.8, UI 0.7). For BombFuse, LaserHum and BombTick I also checked RMS across the clip to confirm they loop evenly. Everything I created went into a temporary folder named AudioScoutTmp and was destroyed; a final scan found 0 leftovers. A Folder "LaserTracerSfx" was already in SoundService and is not mine.

KEY NAMING: each key has a primary entry (key = "X") and a backup entry (key = "X.backup").

To install: write assets/sounds.json (it does not exist yet) as {"UiClick":{"id":"rbxassetid://17208204604","volume":0.7},...} and run tools/gen_assets_lua.py. That fills Assets.Sounds, which is empty right now at src/shared/Assets.lua:77.

FINDINGS FOR THE LEAD:
(1) src/shared/Audio.lua is not called anywhere yet. The game currently builds every sound from 6 sound files built into the Roblox client (action_jump.mp3, action_jump_land.mp3, action_swim.mp3, action_falling, impact_explosion_03.mp3, volume_slider.ogg), pitch-shifted. That happens in src/client/UI/Sfx.lua:8-12, src/client/Shop/Sfx.lua:8-14, src/client/Solo/Sfx.lua:8-12, src/client/Minigames/LaserTracer/Sounds.lua:11-15, src/client/Minigames/Dodgeball/Effects.lua:25-30, src/client/Minigames/Dodgeball/Cannons.lua:99, src/client/Minigames/HoleInTheWall/Fx.lua:97-99, src/client/Minigames/HoleInTheWall/WallView.lua:315, src/client/Minigames/Spin/init.client.lua:79-81, src/client/Minigames/KingOfTheHill/Input.lua:74, src/server/Economy/Visuals.lua:22-23 and src/server/Minigames/KingOfTheHill/BatTool.lua:29-31. All of these should switch to Audio.ui / Audio.play / Audio.at with the keys below.
(2) src/shared/Movement/Assets.lua:22-24 already uses 15675024286 (Dash), 9118771226 (Slide) and 15675059323 (Ready). All three verified, and I reuse them below for Dash, Slide.backup and UiClick.backup.
(3) Audio.lua has no way to loop a sound at a position. Audio.at, playOnce at lines 82-108, always plays once and is destroyed. BombFuse, LaserHum and a looping BombTick need a new function, e.g. Audio.loopAt(key, part) -> Sound, with Looped=true, cleaned up by the caller.
(4) Roblox's default character sounds (the RbxCharacterSounds script) already play jump and land sounds. Either turn those off or skip the Jump and Land keys, otherwise you get double sounds.
(5) The client's built-in rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3 also loads (2.38 s) and works as a no-risk Splash fallback.
